 Order

The petitioner's land was acquired by initiating proceedings under the Tamil Nadu Highways Act,
2001.
The award in relation thereto was issued on 12.08.2025.

Being dissatisfied with the compensation fixed therein, the petitioner submitted a representation dated 13.09.2025 for reference of the matter to the competent civil court for considering the request for enhanced compensation.
2. Learned Government Advocate accepts notice on behalf of both the respondents.

He submits that if an application were to be received in that regard, the matter would be referred within four (4)
weeks from the date of receipt thereof.

3. In view of the above submissions of learned Government Advocate, this Writ Petition is disposed of on the following terms:
(i) The petitioner shall make a request for reference within two (2) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

( ii) Within 4 weeks from the date of receipt thereof, the reference https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 08/10/2025 06:40:05 pm ) shall be made to the competent civil court by the respondents.
